SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.PAGE_DESC: OLED/TFT display driver — themes, burn-in mitigation, quiet hours.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_THEME_DESC: Pick a theme. Default ships with the plugin; custom themes can be uploaded as a zip.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_ACTIVE_THEME_DESC: Switching themes restarts the display service.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_THEMES_MANAGE_DESC: Upload, download, and delete themes. Upload accepts a path to a .zip file on the device; deletes apply immediately.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_UPLOAD_PATH: Path to theme .zip on the device
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_UPLOAD_PATH_DESC: Place your zip somewhere on the Pi (via SCP or Volumio's file manager), then paste the absolute path here.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.BUTTON_DOWNLOAD_DEFAULT_DESC: Grab the default theme as a starting point — unzip, edit colors/fonts/GIFs/layouts, rezip, and upload above to create a new theme.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_ADVANCED_ENABLE_DESC: Tuning knobs for burn-in mitigation, timing, IR remote debounce, and logging. Off by default — leave off unless you know you need them.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_SHOW_ADVANCED_SETTINGS_DESC: When on, the Burn-in, Timing, IR Remote, and Logging sections appear below.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_THEMING_ENABLE_DESC: Custom themes let you replace fonts, colors, and animations. Off by default to keep the settings page short.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_ENABLE_CUSTOM_THEMES_DESC: When on, the Theme and Manage Themes sections appear below.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.TOAST_TOGGLE_SAVED: Saved. Reopen the settings page for the change to take effect.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.INFO_NO_DELETABLE: No themes available to delete (default and active themes are protected).
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_BURNIN_DESC: OLED panels can ghost from static UI. These defenses run at near-zero cost. Disable all of them on TFT/LCD panels.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_QUIET_HOURS_DESC: Panel hard-sleeps in this window. Set both to the same value to disable. Wraps midnight.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_DISPLAY_DESC: Screen type and SPI wiring. Changing screen type without a compatible theme will look broken until you switch themes.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_TIMING_DESC: How long screens persist and how often the display refreshes. Defaults are tuned — change only if you know why.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_IR_DESC: Requires the Volumio ir_controller plugin for IR-to-button decoding. These settings affect how we react to button events, not how IR is decoded.
